name: COVID-19 Market Crash Scenario
description: Simulates the March 2020 pandemic-driven market crash with cross-asset contagion

trigger.event: Global pandemic triggers unprecedented broad-based market selloff

contagion_pathway: Global equity markets (SPY, QQQ, IWM - broad selloff)
→ Financial sector (JPM, BAC, C - credit risk repricing)
→ Credit markets (HYG, LQD - corporate bond selloff, liquidity crisis)
→ Commodities (USO - demand destruction, oil price war)
→ Emerging markets (EEM - capital flight to safety)
→ Even safe havens temporarily affected (GLD down on margin calls)
key_indicators: Credit markets frozen - no bid for corporate bonds
Oil price collapse on demand destruction
Central bank emergency rate cuts and QE
Correlation of all risk assets approaching 1.0
